bg.$description: Raised surface behind the prompt composer.

bg-image.$description: Optional background image painted above the composer surface.

backdrop-filter.$description: Optional whole backdrop filter behind the composer.

fg.$description: Draft text on the composer surface.

placeholder-fg.$description: Placeholder and writing status on the composer surface.

feedback-bg.$description: Surface immediately behind attachment rejection text.

feedback-fg.$description: Attachment rejection text on the composer surface.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the composer surface.

padding.$description: Inset and spacing between rows in the composer.

editor-padding-block.$description: Block inset for the native text field and its sizer.

editor-padding-inline.$description: Inline inset for the native text field and its sizer.

action-gap.$description: Default spacing between attachments and toolbar controls.

min-height.$description: Minimum height of the editable draft.

max-height.$description: Maximum height of the draft before the textarea scrolls.
